text: Six men tapped, "Is there any hope", from inside a sunken submarine.
It's 1927, and a Coast Guard ship chasing whiskey smugglers off Cape Cod rams the S4 as she surfaces.
She drops 30 meters to the seabed with 40 men aboard.
A diver goes down and knocks on the hull,
and from the torpedo room comes six slow knocks back.
Then a winter storm hits, and the divers can't go back down.
One diver fights its way down with an air hose, gets snagged in the wreck, and has to be rescued himself.
Then the question comes, "Is there any hope?"
And the Navy pings back, "There is hope. Everything possible is being done."
By the time the storm cleared, the knocking had stopped.
